available: saved frozen Decision Price, score, rank and selection timestamp
regular 5m OHLC available at bar END per pinned normalizer
OHLC-derived rolling3 state and observed-prefix extrema

calendar.fillLimitation: saved first observed OPEN within 5m is a reference, no guaranteed fill or exact fill timestamp; absence never replaced by next available bar
calendar.missingState: stop as DATA_BLOCKED at first missing completed bar; never convert missing to abstention
calendar.price: after completed bar signal, next contiguous regular bar OPEN only; decision may not inspect next bar HIGH/LOW/CLOSE or future availability
calendar.primaryEligibility: selection+30m within one continuous AM/PM session; lunch-time decisions and boundary crossings structurally ineligible, original rows retained
calendar.primaryExit: exact completed CLOSE selection+30m; pre-existing canonical30 reference fixed before all results
calendar.secondaryBoundary: same continuous session, no lunch crossing or next-day substitution

baselines: existing fixed5 delay control from Economic Alpha DELAYS, no sweep
entryTarget.candidate: only after diagnosticGate; enter once at first positive predicted value at15/20/25, otherwise deliberate ABSTAIN at25; no retry after a missing fill
entryTarget.diagnostic: QUALIFY session-equal Spearman of prediction vs target, plus training-score quintile outcomes and positive-target frequency
entryTarget.economic: reference after-cost forward return; not full-day low prediction
entryTarget.labels: valid completed prefix + observed next OPEN and exact30 close; unknown labels excluded from FIT only and counted, not removed from original policy ledger
entryTarget.policyGate: after diagnosticGate replay QUALIFY, use identical original opportunity IDs and common30 evaluation mask. Both sides deliberate no-trade=0 economic value; unknown prices remain null. Mean trade net and opportunity net separately.

exitTarget.candidate: only after diagnosticGate, exit at next OPEN when prediction>0, otherwise fixed30; no added stop, threshold, reentry or winner filter
exitTarget.frozenComparator: reuse exact existing Candidate A policy and Fixed12 runtime on identical complete12-or-calendar-cap entry-relative paths, separate60/regular-bar comparator; do not change cap to30 and call it frozen. No fit calls through old module.
exitTarget.route: if Entry passes QUALIFY diagnostic+economic Gate, use locked research Entry candidate; else Immediate route. Route chosen before REPORT data are evaluated. No candidate silently created on failure.
exitTarget.state: 15/20/25m since selection, strictly after actual entry; prefix OHLC + entry-relative observed MFE/MAE; no future peaks/winners
exitTarget.value: 100*(next OPEN at state - selection30 CLOSE)/observed Entry price; incremental net value of exit now vs common fixed30, identical cost cancels

features.lag: at least3 completed bars from selection; decisions15/20/25m; no imputation of absent bars
features.prefixExtrema: observed max/min up to decision only; never full-day anatomy values
features.source: existing saved OHLC and frozen metadata; deterministic causal arithmetic only, no new upstream feature acquisition or Selector features
features.standardization: FIT-only weighted mean/std, std floor1 for constants; no clipping or feature selection

finalDecision.D: not selected from failed recoverability alone; redesign efficacy not tested
finalDecision.E: insufficient fit/diagnostic/report sample or major observability prevents required inference
finalDecision.F: adequate tested sample but no passing economic candidate; no proof no possible causal rule

gates.diagnosticGate: positive session-cluster Spearman CI lower >0 on QUALIFY, >=12 sessions >=100 states
gates.finalReportGate: apply same economic criteria once on REPORT for existing candidates; no new candidate or refit if REPORT fails; primary30 only
gates.tail: top positive1%/5% removal, p05 and expected-shortfall5%, negative-return cohorts all retained; no tail deletion in primary

integrated.cumulative: sum net percentage points diagnostic only, overlapping trades not funded portfolio return
integrated.decomposition: entry=10-00; exit=01-00; interaction=11-10-01+00, same opportunity denominator
integrated.noTrade: deliberate abstention0 for opportunity-level sums, no cost; per-trade stats exclude nontrades; blocked/missing null
integrated.when: both candidates pass QUALIFY before REPORT; run4 cells on same complete30 original IDs on REPORT even if final performance is bad

model.fitCount: one Entry diagnostic model; one EXIT diagnostic model on precommitted conditional Entry route; no refit after QUALIFY
model.objective: mean weighted squared error + alpha*sum(beta^2), intercept unpenalized
model.searchSpace: one fixed specification per component, no hyperparameter/threshold/horizon search
model.trigger: >0 predicted economic target; first positive state only; no tuning
model.weights: equal sessions then equal event identities then equal states within event

priorExposure: All 76 sessions already outcome-exposed Development; Frozen Selector fitted on historical C+D. Chronological component-report partition is NOT sealed DEV TEST, independent Fresh/OOS, or unseen system validation.

statistics.labelOverlap: labels stay in same continuous session; FIT/QUALIFY/REPORT session sets disjoint; overlapping intraday labels remain grouped by session
statistics.pairing: exact selectorEventId, same fixed30 terminal; whole original3800 retained. Primary paired metrics on common complete0..30 paths for comparable state/path observability; report missingness and all-original counts. No missing-zero imputation.
statistics.reportAccess: Entry and EXIT models, branch and qualification decisions locked before constructing REPORT targets or replay. All gates/failures saved.
statistics.simultaneousCI: Bonferroni family2 for Entry/EXIT economic and diagnostic main contrasts; descriptive not independent confirmatory
statistics.symbol: repeated symbols not iid, HHI/top symbols/top3-frequency exclusion sensitivity; no symbol filter in policy
statistics.weighting: timestamp equal within session then session equal; trade distribution row-weighted labeled separately
